findings.problem: This diff reverts commit e11187e, whose message says: 'Starlette removed the **env_options passthrough in Jinja2Templates, breaking autoescape=True on newer versions.' The Dockerfile at line 31 runs `pip install --no-cache-dir .`, which ignores uv.lock, and pyproject lists 'fastapi' with no version bound. So every image build pulls the newest Starlette. Once the kwarg is removed, one of two things happens.
